title: Verify European raw transfers during ordinary boot
changes: Verify ordinary e93 raw UI transfer consumption during a retained European clean boot under Wine.
validation: Production CLI on the retained 1200-frame input reports 1372 reads, 5488 served bytes including 16 selector and 5472 payload bytes, four banks and four groups; 92 protected inputs and managed files retain hashes and modification times.

The existing runtime test executable compares all 1200 full serialized states and clocks, central and wide images, OAM, dispatch and five audio streams successfully using the same 605 sources, dataset, input and native cache. No new build or old acceptance replay.
A first Wine invocation could not create its server lock inside the sandbox and produced no game result; the two successful Wine checks used sandbox escalation.
limitations: The ordinary result covers one European boot; other paths, dynamic 6F8 domain and full caller ABI remain open. Both comparison arms use the same native cache and do not prove global interpreter/native parity.
New Linux, USA and native Windows checks remain pending, as does the broader ROM data TODO. No performance measurement.
